description_en: Queries the details of the specified mitigation policies
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafPolicy获取指定防护策略详细信息
name: DescribeDcdnWafPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the mitigation policies. Only a single value is supported
parameters.help_zh: 防护策略ID，仅支持单个输入
parameters.name: policy_id

DefenseScene.description_en:
The type of mitigation policies. The following policy scenarios are currently supported:

waf_group: basic protection.

custom_acl: custom mitigation policies.

whitelist: whitelist
DefenseScene.description_zh:
防护策略类型，目前支持以下场景：

waf_group：Web基础防护。

custom_acl：自定义防护策略。

whitelist：白名单

DomainCount.description_en: The number of domain names that use the mitigation policies
DomainCount.description_zh: 使用该防护策略的域名个数

GmtModified.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in UTC+0 and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the mitigation policies

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the mitigation policies

PolicyStatus.description_en:
The status of the mitigation policies. Valid values:

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
PolicyStatus.description_zh:
防护策略状态，取值：

on：开启。

off：关闭

PolicyType.description_en:
Indicates whether the policy is the default policy. Valid values:

default: Default policy.

custom: Non-default policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
当前策略是否为默认策略，取值：

default：默认策略。

custom：非默认策略

RuleConfigs.description_en: The specific protection rule configurations corresponding to the mitigation policies. Only bot scenarios are supported. For more information, see [BatchCreateDcdnWafRules](~~BatchCreateDcdnWafRules~~)
RuleConfigs.description_zh: 该防护策略对应的具体防护规则配置（仅支持Bot场景）。具体请参见[BatchCreateDcdnWafRules](~~BatchCreateDcdnWafRules~~)

RuleCount.description_en: The number of protection rules under the mitigation policies
RuleCount.description_zh: 该防护策略下的防护规则个数
